breakingChangesNotes:
• The Intel471 Credentials integration is no longer a feed integration. Existing instances must be reconfigured, as the following feed parameters were removed: Fetch indicators (feed), First fetch timestamp (fetch_time), Feed Fetch Interval (feedFetchInterval), Indicator Reputation (feedReputation), Source Reliability (feedReliability), Tags (feedTags), Bypass exclusion list (feedBypassExclusionList), feedExpirationPolicy and feedExpirationInterval.
  • Fetching is now configured through the incident parameters Fetch incidents (isFetch), Incident type (incidentType), First fetch timestamp (first_fetch), Incidents Fetch Interval (incidentFetchInterval), Indicator Reputation (indicator_reputation), Source Reliability (integrationReliability) and Tags (indicator_tags).
  • Credentials are now fetched as incidents of type Intel 471 Leaked Credential instead of indicators. Indicator expiration and exclusion list behavior are no longer controlled by the integration instance.
  • The Intel471 Watcher Alerts integration now recognizes the marketplace (website, product, resource and vendor) and data leak site (post and file listing) alert types on the Verity471 backend. Alerts of these types previously created incidents named UNKNOWN ALERT TYPE whose details were the raw alert payload; they now create incidents with a type-specific name and details. Automations or filters that key on the old incident name or on the raw payload layout must be updated.
